mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id FROM v_user_login u WHERE u.delete_yn = 'N' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.user_type IN ('STAFF', 'EMPLOYEE') AND u.role_ids IS NOT NULL AND u.role_ids <> '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_role r WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.delete_yn = 'N' AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND FIND_IN_SET(r.role_id, u.role_ids) > 0 )
